sentences.text: The first application seeking anticipatory bail on behalf of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 10.01.2025 in BAIL APPLN.76/2025 with liberty to move an application before learned ASJ at the first instance.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that admittedly, the complainant and the applicant knew each other since 2016.
It is pointed out that the allegations with respect to the Section 3(2)(v) of The SC/ST Act were not made in the first complaint on the basis of which the FIR was registered.

It is further submitted that during the pendency of the application seeking anticipatory bail before the learned ASJ, the applicant was given protection and in pursuance of the same he joined the investigation.
It is submitted that the applicant is ready and willing to join the investigation as and when directed by the concerned Investigating Officer.
6. Learned APP for the State, on instructions from the Investigating Officer, submits that one of the mobile numbers needs to be handed over.
Let a notice in writing be given to the applicant with regard to the same.
7. Issue notice.
8. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
9. Learned counsel for the complainant also accepts notice.

On the applicant joining investigation on 13.05.2025 at 04:00 P.M., at P.S. Dwarka North, and,
thereafter, joining the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer, no coercive action shall be taken against
